def evalWires (n : ℕ) (gates : ℕ → Gate) (x : ℕ → Bool) : ℕ → (ℕ → Bool)
  | 0 => x
  | k + 1 =>
      let prev := evalWires n gates x k
      let g := gates k
      let w1 := prev (g.in1 % (n + k))
